Persistence (baseline).why: Naive 'nothing changes' forecast; any useful model must beat it.

Historical profile (baseline).why: Average occupancy for this car park, weekday and time - what static 'busy times' charts show.

Persistence + weekly shape (baseline).why: Current occupancy plus last week's change over the same interval; a strong hand-crafted rule.

Ridge Regression.why: Interpretable linear model; tests whether a linear combination of lags and time explains the target.

Random Forest.why: Non-linear bagged trees; captures interactions (e.g. park x time) and is robust to outliers.

HistGradientBoosting.why: Boosted trees; usually strongest on tabular data, native NaN and categorical support, fast.

Majority class (baseline).why: Always predicts the most common status.

Persistence (baseline).why: Status in h minutes = status now.

Random Forest.why: Non-linear ensemble; class_weight tested for the rarer FULL/HIGH classes.

HistGradientBoosting.why: Boosted trees; strong tabular classifier with class weighting option.

Thresholded HistGradientBoosting.why: Status obtained by applying the LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/FULL thresholds to the selected regressor's forecast.
